title: GroupPractitionerLocationNetworkParticipationSpecialty
description: Represents a practitioner's specialty as part of their network participation from a specific location within a group.

specialtyEffectiveDate.description: The date when the specialty becomes effective for the practitioner's network participation at the specified location.

specialtyTerminationDate.description: The date when the specialty participation ends for the practitioner at the specified location.

status.description: The current status of the practitioner's specialty participation in the network from the specified location.

isBoardCertified.description: Indicates if the practitioner is board certified in this specialty.

isContracted.description: Indicates if the practitioner is contracted for this specialty.

isPractising.description: Indicates if the practitioner is currently practising this specialty.
